purpose: Original static raster backplane for v0.6.2 survivor battle
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: portrait pixel-art deep-space battlefield backplane for a mobile 360-degree space survivor game.
Primary request: an original, quiet, layered galaxy and nebula environment in a cohesive purple-grey, deep navy pixel-science-fiction style. Medium pixel detail, crisp controlled clusters and small dithered transitions. Broad diagonal galactic dust band bending from lower left towards upper right, rich dim plum nebula silhouettes, distant cool blue haze, sparse small warm stars. A very small ancient broken ring wreck far in the upper side, subtle scale cue, less than eight percent of the frame. The central play area is dark and open, with subdued contrast, leaving cyan/gold weapons and orange/violet enemy warning paths readable when composited later. More defined nebula shapes near the sides, depth and cinematic space atmosphere.
Composition/framing: portrait 3:5, intended native 384x640 export. All illustration, no frame or interface. Original background environment only, with no spacecraft, people, enemies, icons, labels, numbers or text. No huge foreground planet or central sun. Avoid star clutter, bright white areas, photoreal smooth airbrush gradients, blur and neon fog over the centre. Every edge should have intentional pixel stair-steps, not a pixel grid overlay.
Color palette: navy #101225 and #17172b, purple-grey #26243b #393449 #57516d, plum-violet #55375e, muted blue #28596c, sparse gold #bd8a51. Main central luminosity low. Raster artwork suitable for nearest-neighbour export.
